title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval of the Department of Public Utilities of a 365 Day Firm Transportations Agreement with Brookhouse Condominium Trust.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 07-GC-28)
